title: 数据倾斜：热 key 打散（salting）前后负载对比
expected_output:
before salting, reducer loads: [5, 95]
skew ratio (max/mean): 1.90
after salting, reducer loads: [56, 44]
skew ratio (max/mean): 1.12
code:
import random
random.seed(7)
docs = (["vip_user"]*90) + ["normal_a"]*5 + ["normal_b"]*5
R = 2
def mh(key, n):
    h = 0
    for ch in key:
        h = (h * 31 + ord(ch)) & 0x7fffffff
    return h % n
loads = [0]*R
for d in docs:
    loads[mh(d, R)] += 1
print("before salting, reducer loads:", loads)
print(f"skew ratio (max/mean): {max(loads)/(sum(loads)/R):.2f}")
S = 4
loads2 = [0]*R
for d in docs:
    salted = f"vip_user_{random.randint(0, S-1)}" if d == "vip_user" else d
    loads2[mh(salted, R)] += 1
print("after salting, reducer loads:", loads2)
print(f"skew ratio (max/mean): {max(loads2)/(sum(loads2)/R):.2f}")
